Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: My Home 3.1 Utensils used at home (12 lessons) By the end of Sub Strand, the lea
Topic 3.2: Furniture at Home
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Furniture at Home, part of My Home 3.1 Utensils used at home (12 lessons) By the end of Sub Strand, the lea in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have furniture at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Furniture at Home together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: learner speaks clearly and effectively when naming the furniture used at home.

Learning to learn: learner learns independently when reading pictures of furniture or manipulating furniture used at home.

Values:
Responsibility :as learner cares and handles furniture used at home appropriately

Integrity: learner enhances self-discipline when using furniture used at home

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Disaster risk reduction: learner observes safety precautions when handling and taking care of furniture used at home

Link to other learning area:

Furniture at home relate to sides of objects in Mathematical Activities
